an11.14:1.1: And then Venerable Subhūti together with the bhikkhu Saddha went up to the Buddha, bowed, and sat down to one side. The Buddha said to him,
an11.14:1.2: “Subhūti, what is the name of this bhikkhu?”
an11.14:1.3: “Sir, the name of this bhikkhu is Saddha. He is the son of the layman Sudatta, and has gone forth out of faith from the lay life to homelessness.”
an11.14:2.1: “Well, I hope this bhikkhu Saddha exhibits the various evidences of faith.”
an11.14:2.2: “Now is the time, Blessed One! Now is the time, Holy One!
an11.14:2.3: Let the Buddha to speak on the evidence of faith.
an11.14:2.4: Now I will find out whether or not this bhikkhu Saddha exhibits the various evidences of faith.”
an11.14:3.1: “Well then, Subhūti, listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”
an11.14:4.1: “Firstly, a bhikkhu is ethical, restrained in the monastic code, conducting themselves well and resorting for alms in suitable places. Seeing danger in the slightest fault, they keep the rules they’ve undertaken.
an11.14:4.2: When a bhikkhu is ethical, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:5.1: Furthermore, a bhikkhu is very learned, remembering and keeping what they’ve learned. These teachings are good in the beginning, good in the middle, and good in the end, meaningful and well-phrased, describing a spiritual practice that’s entirely full and pure. They are very learned in such teachings, remembering them, rehearsing them, mentally scrutinizing them, and penetrating them theoretically.
an11.14:5.2: When a bhikkhu is learned, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:6.1: Furthermore, a bhikkhu has good friends, companions, and associates.
an11.14:6.2: When a bhikkhu has good friends, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:7.1: Furthermore, a bhikkhu is easy to admonish, having qualities that make them easy to admonish. They’re patient, and take instruction respectfully.
an11.14:7.2: When a bhikkhu is easy to admonish, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:8.1: Furthermore, a bhikkhu is deft and tireless in a diverse spectrum of duties for their spiritual companions, understanding how to go about things in order to complete and organize the work.
an11.14:8.2: When a bhikkhu is deft and tireless in a diverse spectrum of duties, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:9.1: Furthermore, a bhikkhu loves the teachings and is a delight to converse with, being full of joy in the teaching and training.
an11.14:9.2: When a bhikkhu loves the teachings, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:10.1: Furthermore, a bhikkhu lives with energy roused up for giving up unskillful qualities and embracing skillful qualities. They are strong, staunchly vigorous, not slacking off when it comes to developing skillful qualities.
an11.14:10.2: When a bhikkhu is energetic, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:11.1: Furthermore, a bhikkhu gets the four stages of meditation—blissful meditations in this life that belong to the higher mind—when they want, without trouble or difficulty.
an11.14:11.2: When a bhikkhu gets the four stages of meditation, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:12.1: Furthermore, a bhikkhu recollects many kinds of past lives.
an11.14:12.2: That is: one, two, three, four, five, ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, a hundred, a thousand, a hundred thousand rebirths; many eons of the world contracting, many eons of the world expanding, many eons of the world contracting and expanding. They remember: ‘There, I was named this, my clan was that, I looked like this, and that was my food. This was how I felt pleasure and pain, and that was how my life ended. When I passed away from that place I was reborn somewhere else. There, too, I was named this, my clan was that, I looked like this, and that was my food. This was how I felt pleasure and pain, and that was how my life ended. When I passed away from that place I was reborn here.’ And so they recollect their many kinds of past lives, with features and details.
an11.14:12.3: When a bhikkhu recollects many kinds of past lives, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:13.1: Furthermore, with clairvoyance that is purified and superhuman, a bhikkhu sees sentient beings passing away and being reborn—inferior and superior, beautiful and ugly, in a good place or a bad place. They understand how sentient beings pass on according to their deeds. ‘These dear beings did bad things by way of body, speech, and mind. They denounced the noble ones; they had wrong view; and they chose to act out of that wrong view. When their body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell. These dear beings, however, did good things by way of body, speech, and mind. They never denounced the noble ones; they had right view; and they chose to act out of that right view. When their body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.’ And so, with clairvoyance that is purified and superhuman, they see sentient beings passing away and being reborn—inferior and superior, beautiful and ugly, in a good place or a bad place. They understand how sentient beings pass on according to their deeds.
an11.14:13.2: When a bhikkhu has clairvoyance that is purified and superhuman, this is evidence of faith.
an11.14:14.1: Furthermore, a bhikkhu has realized the undefiled freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom in this very life, and lives having realized it with their own insight due to the destruction of defilements.
an11.14:14.2: When a bhikkhu has ended the defilements, this is evidence of faith.”
an11.14:15.1: When he said this, Venerable Subhūti said to the Buddha:
an11.14:15.2: “Sir, the various evidences of faith for a faithful person that the Buddha speaks of are found in this bhikkhu; he does exhibit them.
an11.14:19.1: This bhikkhu is easy to admonish …
an11.14:20.1: This bhikkhu is deft and tireless in a diverse spectrum of duties …
an11.14:23.1: This bhikkhu gets the four stages of meditation …
an11.14:24.1: This bhikkhu recollects their many kinds of past lives …
an11.14:25.1: This bhikkhu has clairvoyance that is purified and surpasses the human …
an11.14:26.1: This bhikkhu has ended the defilements …
an11.14:26.2: The various evidences of faith for a faithful person that the Buddha speaks of are found in this bhikkhu; he does exhibit them.”
an11.14:27.2: So, Subhūti, you should live together with this bhikkhu Saddha.
an11.14:27.3: And when you want to see the Realized One, you should come together with him.”
